column3: “harden” renders “make strong,” and “I will be honored” renders “I will get glory.”
NASB supplies “other” in “all the other chariots.”
“hardened” renders “made strong,” and “boldly” renders “with a raised hand.”
“harden” renders “make strong,” and “be honored” renders “get glory” (also in verse 18).
NASB adds “along with” and “yet” to smooth a terse clause, “and it was the cloud and the darkness, and it lit up the night”; the meaning is uncertain.
“swept the sea back” renders “made the sea go.”
“to swerve” renders “turned aside (removed)”; “Let us flee” renders the collective “let me flee.”
“at daybreak” renders “at the turning of morning,” and “overthrew” renders “shook off.”
